summary: @ornikar/graphql-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Version 1.1.6 of @ornikar/graphql-config declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip into a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and executes a bundled 727KB `math_init.js` file under that runtime. The `setup.mjs` installer uses hex-mangled identifiers and per-call property aliasing to hide its behavior, and `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing a shuffled string-array rotator (`WV8StW`/`n7gIxM`) characteristic of obfuscator.io-style protection. The package is advertised as a GraphQL configuration helper and has no functional need for an alternate runtime. The behavior matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern in which a non-Node runtime is fetched at install time solely to execute a sibling obfuscated payload, evading Node-oriented inspection. Purpose mismatch with the declared `@ornikar` scope and homepage (github.com/ornikar/shared-configs) is consistent with a maintainer-account compromise or scope hijack rather than a legitimate release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
